{{Quote|It's crushed our weapons! Quick, ''Seeker'' &mdash; sound the alarm! You've got to warn the base!|A clone trooper, to Seeker|<ref name="Mandalorian Memories" />}}
'''Seeker''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Mandalorian Memories" /> A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Seeker was created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="Clone Databank" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> Sometime between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWdates|420}} Since the comic story "[[Mandalorian Memories]]" shows how [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] acquired the armor he is seen wearing in the episode, it must take place during or prior to 20 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]]. The story must also take place no earlier than [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], since it takes place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes to have begun in 22 BBY.</ref> Seeker wore white [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] and carried a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15 blaster]] while stationed as a guard in [[Timira City]] on Kamino. Seeker, along with two other clones, were standing on duty when the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Nub Jakkak]] arrived on a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. However, a trio of [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] had stowed away atop the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and the hunters, led by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Korasa job|attacked]] the clones. One of the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] told Seeker to sound the alarm after the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[C-21 Highsinger/Legends|C-21 Highsinger]] destroyed their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Seeker ran to alert the base, but the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] bounty hunter [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] tossed Jakkak at Seeker, knocking them out.<ref name="Mandalorian Memories" />

==Behind the scenes==
Seeker appeared during a flashback in "[[Mandalorian Memories]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] that featured in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.41|forty-first issue of the sixth volume]] of the [[Star Wars Comic|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic]] magazine. The comic was written by [[Robin Etherington]], with Seeker's design created by artist [[Andres Ponce]],<ref name="Mandalorian Memories" /> and was published on [[December 13]], [[2012]].<ref name="ComicRelease">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.40|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.40]]</ref>
